title: 7-Day InterContinental Danang Peninsular Golf Escape
description: Ultra-luxury peninsular sanctuary at InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort. Play Montgomerie Links, Ba Na Hills, and Hoiana Shores.

signatureTour.title: The Central Coast Classic
signatureTour.highlight: Upgrade to our fully hosted Central Coast tour with dedicated host, private boat transfers, and curated VIP golf access.

inclusions.detail: Dedicated private luxury transfers for all airport, resort, and golf course journeys.
3 rounds at Montgomerie Links, Ba Na Hills, and Hoiana Shores.
6 nights in a Resort Classic Ocean View Room at InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort.
Signature sound vibration therapy and post-golf physical relaxation.
On-ground concierge handling tee sheets, caddie pairings, and Michelin dining reservations.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Son Tra Peninsula & Bill Bensley Design Sanctuaries
itinerary.subtitle: Peninsular Arrival
itinerary.imageCaption: InterContinental Da Nang — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: InterContinental Da Nang luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Da Nang International Airport and travel via private executive vehicle out along the secluded Son Tra Peninsula to InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort, Bill Bensley's legendary cliffside masterpiece overlooking Monkey Bay.

Ride the resort's iconic Nam Tram funicular down through the Heaven, Sky, Earth, and Sea levels to your ocean-view sanctuary. Enjoy a sunset welcome cocktail at the cliffside Long Bar before an introductory dinner overlooking the private cove.

itinerary.title: Strategic European Links at Montgomerie Links Vietnam
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: Colin Montgomerie Coastal Layout
itinerary.imageCaption: Montgomerie Links Vietnam — Colin Montgomerie (Par 72, 7,091 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Montgomerie Links Vietnam championship golf course Colin Montgomerie Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Travel along the Da Nang coastline to Montgomerie Links Vietnam. Colin Montgomerie's 7,090-yard links layout challenges your course management with deep pot bunkering, wispy dunes grass, and slick Paspalum putting surfaces.

Following your round, unwind with a cold Tiger beer at the clubhouse terrace before your private driver transfers you back to the secluded peninsula for an evening of relaxation in your oceanfront suite.

itinerary.title: Mountain Jungle Grandeur at Ba Na Hills Golf Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Luke Donald Mountain Parkland
itinerary.imageCaption: Ba Na Hills Golf Club — Luke Donald / IMG (Par 72, 7,858 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Ba Na Hills Golf Club championship golf course Luke Donald / IMG Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tackle Ba Na Hills Golf Club, Luke Donald’s world-acclaimed mountain valley design. Surrounded by virgin native rainforest and dramatic elevation shifts, the course demands courageous driving and astute iron play.

Conclude your round with lunch on the open-air clubhouse deck before an executive transfer returns you to the resort for an evening hydrotherapy session at the Mi Sol Spa.

itinerary.title: Monkey Bay Seclusion & Mi Sol Spa Restoration
itinerary.subtitle: Peninsula Day of Rest
itinerary.imageCaption: InterContinental Da Nang — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: InterContinental Da Nang luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
A full day dedicated to the world-class amenities of the Sun Peninsula Resort. Lounge by the oceanfront L_o_n_g Pool, watch wild red-shanked douc langurs playing in the canopy, or take a private sailing catamaran out into Monkey Bay.

In the evening, experience world-class fine dining at La Maison 1888, curated with French gastronomic mastery and an extraordinary international wine cellar.

itinerary.title: Pure Coastal Dunes Links Finale at Hoiana Shores
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: RTJ II Ocean Links Test
itinerary.imageCaption: Hoiana Shores Golf Club — Robert Trent Jones Jr. (Par 72, 7,309 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Hoiana Shores Golf Club championship golf course Robert Trent Jones Jr. Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Journey south across the Cua Dai bridge to play Hoiana Shores Golf Club, Robert Trent Jones II's seaside links jewel. Firm running Zeon Zoysia fairways, sprawling blowout bunkers, and coastal winds make this one of the most thrilling links tests in Asia.

Toast the completion of your golf rounds on the ocean clubhouse terrace before returning to your cliffside sanctuary for a private balcony dinner beneath the stars.

itinerary.title: Peninsula Relaxation & Farewell Seafood Feast
itinerary.subtitle: Cliffside Leisure
itinerary.imageCaption: InterContinental Da Nang — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: InterContinental Da Nang luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy an unhurried morning with breakfast on the terrace at Citron, sitting in the iconic inverted non la dining booths suspended high over the East Sea.

Spend the afternoon relaxing on the 700-meter private crescent beach before gathering for a celebratory farewell seafood feast at Barefoot beachfront restaurant.

itinerary.title: VIP Departure via Da Nang Airport
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageCaption: InterContinental Da Nang — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: InterContinental Da Nang luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Take a final swim or morning walk along the private beach before packing your equipment with assistance from your AGS Local Guardian.

Your private executive transfer delivers you directly to Da Nang International Airport for your return flight, bringing your peninsular golf retreat to an effortless close.

faqs.question: How far is the resort from the golf courses?
faqs.answer: Montgomerie Links and BRG Da Nang are approximately 40 minutes away, while Ba Na Hills is roughly 55 minutes via private highway transfer.
